lead: A side navigation tree, driven by data: leaves are links or buttons, items with `children` are expandable submenus, and there are group headings and dividers. It can collapse to a narrow icon rail (submenus pop out on hover), and inside a `Sidebar` it collapses with it. For a horizontal top navigation, use Navigation Menu.

controlled.title: Controlled
controlled.description: You own `selectedKey` / `openKeys`; the ancestors of the selected item are open by default. Keyboard: Up / Down move, Right expands, Left collapses or goes back to the parent.

sidebar.title: In a Sidebar
sidebar.description: Inside a `Sidebar` (`collapsible="icon"`): click the toggle and the menu shrinks to an icon rail; on the rail, leaves show a tooltip on hover and submenus pop out.

collapsed.title: Collapsed
collapsed.description: Outside a `Sidebar`, control it yourself with `collapsed`.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Used alone it is light by default; `theme="dark"` makes it dark. Inside a `Sidebar` you don't set it: it follows the Sidebar.

links.title: Links, disabled, danger
links.description: An item with `href` is a real link (open in a new tab and copy link both work); with a router, call `preventDefault` in `onSelect` and navigate yourself.

api.title: API Reference
api.itemIntro: An entry of `items`: a leaf, a submenu (with `children`), a `{ type: "group" }` group or a `{ type: "divider" }` line.

item.key: Unique key across the whole menu; used by `selectedKey`, `openKeys` and `onSelect`
item.label: The visible text
item.icon: Icon in front (all that is left on the collapsed rail)
item.href: When given, the item renders as a link; otherwise it is a button
item.flags: Greyed out and not selectable / a danger color for destructive actions
item.title: The tooltip and accessible name when collapsed (may be omitted when `label` is a string)

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Theme styles define the item height, indentation, selected colour and expand animation in `side-menu.css`. The antd theme style's dark menu uses a darkened primary colour; the other theme styles mix every colour from the current text colour, so the menu works in both light and dark sidebars.
styling.root: The root (`<nav>`); `data-collapsed`, `data-theme`; a popped-out submenu has `data-popup`
styling.panel: The expanding area, `data-open`; animated with a grid row from `0fr` to `1fr`
styling.parts: Group, group title, divider, icon and label
